rationale.skip: Not skipping. The change is user-facing dashboard behavior, not docs/CI/comment-only, and there is no tests-added label or skip request in the trigger comment. No explicit opt-out is present.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. ViewDashboard.vue's computeAllPanelTimes now distinguishes relative from absolute global time ranges, comparing relative ranges by span and only updating the __global time when the span actually changed. This alters user-visible refresh behavior: relative-range dashboards should stop spuriously refetching panels on load while still refreshing correctly on forced refresh. That behavior needs verification in a real UI flow.
